dict.string: Ve.Ai uses your microphone for voice features and quick voice interactions. We only listen when you explicitly engage voice features.
Ve.Ai includes a mirror feature that lets you quickly check your appearance using your camera, right from the notch. Your camera is never used without your consent, and nothing is recorded or stored.
Ve.Ai can show all your upcoming events in one place. Your calendar data is only used to display your schedule and is never shared.
Ve.Ai can show your scheduled reminders alongside your calendar events. Your reminders data is only used to display your reminders and is never shared.
